decks.name: LeetCode #268 - Missing Number
decks.description: Find the missing number in an array containing n distinct numbers in the range [0, n]

cards.question: Missing Number: Given an array nums containing n distinct numbers in the range [0, n], return the only number in the range that is missing from the array.

solutions.name: Math
solutions.explanation: Use the mathematical formula: expected sum minus actual sum equals missing number. The expected sum of 0 to n is n times n plus one divided by two, but we can calculate the difference iteratively to avoid integer overflow.

semanticLines: Define function missingNumber that accepts array nums
Get length of nums and assign to res
Loop through range from zero to length of nums
Get index i, get element nums at i, subtract nums at i from i, add result to res, and assign back to res
Return res
Define function missingNumber that accepts array nums
Get length of nums and assign to res
Start for loop with i from zero while i less than length of nums incrementing i
Get index i, get element nums at i, subtract nums at i from i, add result to res, and assign back to res

solutions.timeDescription: Linear time as we traverse the array once
solutions.spaceDescription: Constant space using only a single variable
solutions.exampleWalkthrough: Given nums=[3,0,1]: res=3 (length). i=0: res+=0-3=-3, res=0. i=1: res+=1-0=1, res=1. i=2: res+=2-1=1, res=2. Return 2.

solutions.name: Bitwise XOR
solutions.explanation: XOR has the property that a XOR a equals zero and a XOR zero equals a. XOR all indices 0 to n with all array values. Duplicate values cancel out, leaving only the missing number.
